world.title: Law & Disorder: Mondstadt
world.description: A modern, 2026 Earth-adjacent Teyvat police procedural, workplace comedy and Omegaverse romance.
world.setting_summary: Mondstadt City in a modern Teyvat with no magic. Omegaverse biology and modern civic institutions are part of daily life.
world.world_rules: The police force is the Knights of Favonius. The setting supports standalone episodes and a persistent romance; neither requires the other to advance in every session.
